title: Measuring the benefits of your service
locator: Discovery; Alpha; Show improvement; Scrutinise your assumptions
short_quote: Focus on scrutinising your riskiest assumptions.
claim: Early estimates may use assumptions. A baseline, alternative solutions, delivery costs and sensitivity to uncertain inputs support comparison; metrics and later observations update the model.
limits: Guidance for service investment and benefits. It does not prescribe a feature ranking formula, a numerical confidence threshold, or measured effectiveness for this Skill.
publication_safety: Metadata and short quotation only; retained source text stays private.
